description: Resource attributes for storage_object resources. Populated by ResourceDescriptors.StorageObject.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant identifier. Used by islamuevent_tenant_admin derived role.

owningResourceKind.description: Kind of the resource that will own the uploaded object during provider-neutral upload-session creation.

owningResourceId.description: Identifier of the resource that will own the uploaded object when it is known before upload finalization.

purpose.description: Storage-object purpose requested by the upload-session command, such as event image or attachment.

visibility.description: Requested storage-object visibility for the upload session.
